message.content: Briar suggests adding quick one-twos to the passing practice during the weekend session. This idea is brought up with enthusiasm as it would not only make the practice more interesting but also serve as a good workout, helping to improve stamina while practicing the passes. The specific mention of quick one-twos indicates that Briar wants to incorporate dynamic and fast-paced passing drills into their training to simulate game-like situations and enhance the players' skills in transitioning the ball during actual matches.
